strings.name: Carlo Ancelotti
strings.summary: Ancelotti moved from playing midfield for Parma, Roma and AC Milan to coaching champions in Italy, England, France, Germany and Spain. He won five Champions League titles with Milan and Real Madrid, adapting to different squads and managing prominent players. He took charge of Brazil in 2025 and renewed his contract in 2026 through the 2030 World Cup cycle.
